english:
Melee, Glaive Melee, and Sword hits grant a stack of 'Initiative' for 8 seconds. Maximum of 5 stacks. Stacks decay one at a time.

Initiative grants ?|?|?|?|30 Handling and Reload Speed at 1|2|3|4|5 stacks, with 20% decreased Handling Animation Duration at 5 stacks.

Hits against immune enemies also build stacks, as does damage over time from sources such as Sword Storm Combo, <void Smoke Bomb />, and <solar Scorch />.

source.text:
2 Piece | Taking Initiative

Upon scoring a Melee, Glaive Melee, or Sword Damage Instance:
Grants a stack of Initiative for 8 seconds, up to a maximum of 5 stacks. Stacks decay one at a time.
Initiative grants up to +30 Handling, 0.8x Handling Duration Multiplier, and +30 Reload Speed at 5 stacks.
Can stack on Immune Enemies and with DoT as well, such as Sword Storm Combo, Smoke Bomb, and Scorch Ticks.
